text: Replace criterion 3: until the records-history build (D111) lands, a squash of a job's landing plus any later commit is not a valid landing (that is how squash 02837e0 broke the history check), so land_pr refuses when the pull request's current head is anything other than the job's landing commit, declared intervention or not, and names the extra commits; criterion 2's refusal covers all of them. Keep the rest: checks and the merge guard are keyed to the pull request's current head, and land_pr never force-replaces a newer head.
